positions.title: CSR II - Retention Specialist
positions.description:
•	Inbound calls primarily concerning dissatisfaction of service and threats to cancel accounts
•	Increased training on technical troubleshooting and work arounds for extenuating situations

positions.title: Stand-In Team Leader
positions.description:
•	Took lead of team meetings, agent developments, and coaching when normal Team Lead was unavailable
•	Point of Contact for fellow agents on issues uncertain of and escalated calls requiring a supervisor

positions.title: CSR I - Sales Specialist
positions.description:
•	Inbound calls concerning account details, service upgrades, equipment inquiries, programming concerns
•	Educated solutions to lower cost, improve service, promotional deals, and scheduled technicians after confirmation of issue not software related

positions.title: Shift Manager
positions.description:
•	Labor and inventory waste tracking for each shift 
•	Targeted manageable times for service and quality goals
•	Positioned workstations to cross train service and production crew members
•	Completed truck orders for store resupply
•	Cleaned, maintained, and repaired industrial equipment
•	Ensured all food safety standards and guidelines were followed
•	Point of contact for any disgruntled customers

positions.title: Crew Trainer
positions.description:
•	Trained/Coached all new hires for 5 other stores that fell under Area Supervisor of our store
•	Responsible for continued training of existing and new, menu items, policies, performance expectations as they were implemented by upper management

positions.title: Crew Member
positions.description: •	Food preparation and production, stocking, cleaning, opening/closing of store and all other related tasks
